result.instructions: Tools for Bookingmood, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who arrives at my properties this weekend?"; "Which payments are still open and past their due date?"; "Is the beach house free from 12 to 19 July for 4 guests, and at what price?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bookingmood data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bookingmood_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bookingmood_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bookingmood_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bookingmood_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: The Bookingmood organization this API key belongs to: name, company, plan (tier, subscription type, expiry), languages, country, VAT number, custom domain and contact details. Payment-provider ids and secrets are not returned. GET /organizations.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_products
tools.title: List products (rentals)
tools.description: List the rentable products (apartments, rooms, boats, bikes...) with name, currency, timezone, rent period (daily/nightly), booking interaction, fee and deposit. Names and descriptions are objects keyed by language ('default', 'nl-NL', ...). Images are not returned. GET /products.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One product by id with its capacities (guest-group min/max limits) embedded. GET /products?id=eq.{id}&select=*,capacities(*).

tools.name: bookingmood_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest first: reference, method (request or book), currency, confirmed_at (null = not confirmed yet), created_at. A booking's dates and guests are on its calendar events (bookingmood_list_calendar_events) and contacts. Filter by creation date, confirmation state or reference text. The guest access secret is never returned. GET /bookings.

created_from.description: Only bookings created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Only bookings created on or before this date.

confirmed.description: true = only confirmed bookings, false = only unconfirmed ones.

method.description: 'request' = booking request awaiting approval, 'book' = instant booking.

reference.description: Text contained in the booking reference.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking with details
tools.description: One booking with everything attached: its calendar events (dates, product, status, occupancy, notes), line items, payments, invoices and the guest contacts linked to it. Five or six read requests. The guest contacts come from the booking-contact link table; if that lookup fails the reply says so instead of failing. GET /bookings, /calendar_events, /line_items, /payments, /invoices, /contact_bookings, /contacts.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events: bookings (type 'booking'), blocked periods and notes, with product_id, booking_id, start_date, end_date, status (TENTATIVE, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED), occupancy, title and notes. Use the date filters for arrivals/departures (e.g. start_date_from = start_date_to = today lists today's arrivals) or active_on for who is in the property on a day. Ordered by start date. GET /calendar_events.

start_date_from.description: start_date on or after this date (arrivals from).

start_date_to.description: start_date on or before this date (arrivals until).

end_date_from.description: end_date on or after this date (departures from).

end_date_to.description: end_date on or before this date (departures until).

active_on.description: Only events that cover this date (start_date <= date <= end_date).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_check_availability
tools.title: Check availability
tools.description: Availability calendar of up to 5 products: per product a list of intervals {start, end, status} with status available, tentative, unavailable, booked or reserved. One request per product. GET /availability?product_id={id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_search_products
tools.title: Search available products
tools.description: Which products can be booked for a stay: for each product whether it matches the dates, guest numbers and options, its availability and a price range {min, max}. Read-only (a search; nothing is booked). occupancy maps a capacity-group id (from bookingmood_get_product capacities) to a number of guests. POST /search.

occupancy.description: Map of capacity-group id (UUID) to the number of guests of that group, e.g. adults.

option_ids.description: Attribute option ids (UUIDs) the product must have.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts (guests)
tools.description: List contacts (guests and customers): name, email, phone, company, address, language, notes. Search by name, email or company (case-insensitive, contains). Newest first. GET /contacts.

name.description: Text contained in the contact name.

email.description: Text contained in the email address.

company.description: Text contained in the company name.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id. GET /contacts?id=eq.{id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments (deposits, balances, offline payments): booking_id, invoice_id, amount and paid (integers; the API reference does not state the unit, normally the smallest currency unit), currency, due_at, completed_at (null = not paid), status, offline. Filter to unpaid payments, a booking or a due date. Ordered by due date, latest first. GET /payments.

completed.description: true = only completed payments, false = only open ones.

due_from.description: due_at on or after this date.

due_to.description: due_at on or before this date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices: reference, booking_id, attachment (a custom uploaded file URL, if any), created_at. Filter by booking or creation date. Newest first. GET /invoices.

reference.description: Text contained in the invoice reference.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_line_items
tools.title: List line items
tools.description: List invoice/booking line items: name (per language), amount and quantity (integers; the API reference does not state the unit), item_type (rent, fee...), fee_type (fee or deposit), booking_id, event_id, invoice_id. GET /line_items.

booking_id.description: Only line items of this booking.

invoice_id.description: Only line items of this invoice.

event_id.description: Only line items of this calendar event.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List discount coupons: code, description, definition, quota, scope (global, product, service, rent), stackable. Deleted coupons are left out. GET /coupons.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_services
tools.title: List services (extras and fees)
tools.description: List services: the extras, fees and form fields guests can add to a booking, with label, type, fee, deposit and description. GET /services.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List housekeeping/operations tasks attached to calendar events: label, due_at, completed_at (null = open), schedule (manual, arrival, departure), calendar_event_id. Filter to open tasks or a due-date window. Earliest due first. GET /tasks.

completed.description: true = only completed tasks, false = only open ones.

calendar_event_id.description: Only tasks of this calendar event.

due_from.description: due_at on or after this date.

due_to.description: due_at on or before this date.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_list_messages
tools.title: List guest messages
tools.description: List the e-mails and SMS Bookingmood sent or scheduled to guests: subject, body, type (email or sms), status (sent, manually-scheduled, scheduled-around-arrival, scheduled-around-departure), send_at, booking_id. The rendered HTML is not returned. Latest first. GET /messages.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: bookingmood_update_event_notes
tools.title: Set calendar event notes
tools.description: WRITE: replace the internal notes of ONE calendar event (the whole notes text is overwritten, so include the existing text if you want to keep it - read it first with bookingmood_list_calendar_events). Notes are internal; no guest is notified. PATCH /calendar_events?id=eq.{id}.

notes.description: The new notes text (an empty string clears the notes).

tools.name: bookingmood_set_event_status
tools.title: Set calendar event status (confirm / cancel)
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of ONE calendar event to CONFIRMED, TENTATIVE or CANCELLED. This changes what the calendar shows as available and can trigger Bookingmood's own automations for the booking (guest e-mails, tasks, payment reminders), so confirm with the user before cancelling or confirming. PATCH /calendar_events?id=eq.{id}.

tools.name: bookingmood_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new contact (guest/customer) in Bookingmood. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two contacts, so search with bookingmood_list_contacts first. No message is sent to the contact. POST /contacts.

language.description: Contact language, e.g. en-US or nl-NL.

tools.name: bookingmood_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of ONE existing contact (only the fields you pass are changed; others stay). No message is sent to the contact. PATCH /contacts?id=eq.{id}.

language.description: Contact language, e.g. en-US or nl-NL.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Bookingmood
prompts.description: What you can do with Bookingmood here, with example requests to try.
